runtimePolicy.minimumEffectiveNodeReason: The selected eslint-plugin-jsdoc 54.7.0 requires Node >=20.11.0; this remains inside the declared major-range policy and CI 20.x resolves to a compatible current Node 20 patch.
runtimePolicy.reproducibility: Exact dependency pins, the committed registry-only lockfile, and byte-deterministic generation provide reproducibility without an exact Node patch gate.
runtimePolicy.policy: Use installed Node 24.20.0 for local scaffold, install, and lockfile work. Build, lint, unit tests, and deterministic generation checks run on current Node 20.x, 22.x, and 24.x patches.

runtimeDependencies.compatibility: Depends on @salesforce/core ^8.31.4 and @oclif/core ^4.11.4, so the selected direct pins deduplicate within those compatible major lines.

commandPolicy.adapters: thin CLI adapters over internal services

yaml.acceptanceBehavior: Treat every document.errors entry as fatal before toJS is consumed. A synthetic duplicate-key probe produced code DUPLICATE_KEY with line, column, and byte-position diagnostics.
yaml.customTagOrCodeExecution: disabled; no custom tags and no schema-specific executable types

refResolver.allowedRefs: internal document fragments beginning with #/ only
refResolver.algorithm: Decode RFC 6901 ~1 and ~0 pointer tokens, traverse own-properties only from the parsed document root, and maintain a visited-ref stack for deterministic cycle diagnostics. Report the source operation, original ref, and failing pointer segment. Never read another file and never call a network API.
refResolver.localValidation: 0A3/0P1b must add fixtures proving internal resolution plus rejection of remote, file, escape, malformed, and unresolved refs before the canonical document is parsed.

openApiValidator.scope: OpenAPI 3.0 document identity, required selected-operation fields, unique normalized method/path identities, and all refs reachable from selected operations
openApiValidator.nonGoal: No generic OpenAPI client generation and no broad speculative schema coercion

outputs: reviewed low-risk DTO and type aliases
typeGeneration.dynamicOrPolymorphicBodies: explicit reviewed types or unknown plus runtime validators

serialization.json: repository-owned stable serializer with recursively lexical keys and LF two-space indentation
serialization.typescript: repository-owned emitter with lexical declaration and member ordering

formatter.role: May format emitted TypeScript only; it is not the JSON serializer and its output must pass byte-stability tests.

assertions.reason: Retains the established Salesforce CLI test style and CommonJS-compatible Chai 4 API rather than introducing Chai 6 migration work.

lintFormatHygiene.policy: Package-local ESLint 9 flat config, TypeScript recommended configs, workspace-mandated Prettier/JSDoc/Unicorn stack, zero warnings, LF, and UTF-8 without BOM. Do not add eslint-plugin-mocha 12 because it requires Node >=22 and ESLint >=10; use core flat-config test globals/rules unless a Node-20-compatible exact alternative is separately justified before 0A3 locks the scaffold.

dependencyPolicy.manifestPins: Every dependency and devDependency named by this decision is exact, without ranges or tags.
dependencyPolicy.overrides: exact versions only when independently justified
dependencyPolicy.lockfileIntegrityReference: deferred to 0A3 because no package-lock.json exists in 0A2
